response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)) as bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), cross_media_average AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_bytes_per_ms FROM media_type_stats), filtered_media_types AS (SELECT mts.avg_unit_price, mts.bytes_per_ms, cma.avg_bytes_per_ms FROM media_type_stats mts CROSS JOIN cross_media_average cma WHERE mts.bytes_per_ms > cma.avg_bytes_per_ms) SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) as avg_of_avg_unit_prices, AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_of_bytes_per_ms, AVG(bytes_per_ms - avg_bytes_per_ms) as avg_rate_above_average FROM filtered_media_types
